newsitem.title: USA: Canada spot natgas eases from week ago on weather.
newsitem.headline: Canada spot natgas eases from week ago on weather.

text.p: Canadian natural gas prices were mostly softer Wednesday as milder temperatures in the West and ample storage supplies in the East weakened demand, market sources said.

At the AECO storage hub, prices for Thursday delivery lost 11 cents on the week to C$1.77-1.80 per gigajoule (GJ) as today's forecasts in Calgary called for a temperature high of 20 degrees Celsius. These prices compare with C$1.76-1.77 on Tuesday.
May AECO was talked at C$1.77-1.79, while May/October business hovered in the C$1.72-1.73 per GJ area.
